tuneRef.title: I'm Not ashamed To Own My Lord

lines: Click Here To Play Originial Edition:
That stone is made head corner stone which builders did despise. This is the doing of the Lord, and wondrous in our eyes.
This is the day the Lord hath made; Let us be glad and sing. Hosanna Lord! O give success! O Lord, salvation bring!
O Blessed be the one who comes, comes in Jehovah's name! The blessing of Jehovah's house upon you we proclaim.
Thou art my God; I'll give Thee thanks. My God I'll worship Thee. O thank the Lord, for He is good; His grace will endless be! A-MEN
